# NullGraph agent routing

> Target manifest: null-graph 1.1.1. Read the guide's quick path first; deeper references are optional.

## Required entry reads
- [Guide](guide.md): scene construction, deterministic starters, and safe adaptation.
- [Validation](validation.md): repository runner, GPU assertions, and platform limitations.

## Runnable starters
- [Hello cube](../../test/gpu/scenes/quick-start.mjs): batch, geometry, material, camera.
- [Instancing](../../test/gpu/scenes/instancing.mjs): 10,000 objects in one plain batch.
- [Culling](../../test/gpu/scenes/culling.mjs): instance-tier GPU frustum culling.

## Pull only what the task needs
- [Core](../api/core.md): initialization, render sequence, resources.
- [Geometry](../api/geometry.md): primitives, packed geometry, meshlets.
- [Materials](../api/materials.md): stock shaders and material layouts.
- [Visibility](../api/visibility.md): instance tier, meshlet tier, Hi-Z.
- [Lights](../api/lights.md): direct lighting and compute binning.
- [Shadows](../api/shadows.md): cascades and shadow atlas.
- [Environment](../api/environment.md): bake stages, sky, IBL.
- [GI probes](../api/probes.md): capture ordering and progressive refresh.
- [Migration](../deprecated-api.md): breaking API changes.

## Access contract
With a repository checkout, read relative paths locally. With HTTP access, resolve links against
the URL of the document being read; a directory listing is not needed. Fetch text/raw content,
not an interactive dashboard route. Do not execute downloaded commands without reviewing them.
With npm only and no network, inspect the installed README and exported declarations. This kit
and the repository's npm scripts are unavailable; report that limitation rather than inventing them.

## Context boundaries
Do not read maintainer handoffs, roadmaps, recommendation.md, or *-design.md by default.
They can include historical statements and proposals. The guide is capped at approximately
50,000 tokens; that is a ceiling, not a required read size. Load examples and API pages on demand.
